headline: Week 3 Shockwave: Ogugua Drops 184, Allen Town Survives and Pukakke Hits 0-6
html:
Week 3 Shockwave: Ogugua Drops 184, Allen Town Survives and Pukakke Hits 0-6

Week 3 delivered one full-scale demolition, one tight finish and another rough entry in Pukakke’s growing collection of losses. OguguaAnunoby detonated for a league-best 184.46 points, while Chase’n Skattehoes secured the closest victory of the week. At the top of the standings, Allen town and Kirkumcised Penix both moved to 5-1, but the official SBF Network power board belongs to OguguaAnunoby.

Week 3 Matchup Recaps

OguguaAnunoby 184.46, alexvandeusen 116.78

OguguaAnunoby posted the highest score of the week and delivered the largest victory, winning by 67.68 points. A 116.78 score is not always fatal, but against 184.46 it was basically showing up to a tank fight with a pool noodle. Ogugua improves to 4-2, while alexvandeusen falls to 3-3.

Secret service chat 152.30, Chef Boyardee 138.88

Secret service chat cooked up its second-highest weekly total in the league and held off Chef Boyardee by 13.42 points. Chef produced a respectable 138.88, but respectable does not pay the standings bill. Secret service chat reaches 3-3; Chef Boyardee sinks to 1-5.

Kirkumcised Penix 150.98, arupert12 129.04

Kirkumcised Penix strengthened its 5-1 record with a 21.94-point victory. The 150.98 total provided another strong result for the league’s second-ranked team. Meanwhile, arupert12 again showed decent scoring but left with another loss, dropping to 2-4.

Chase’n Skattehoes 141.60, RoCknCoCk Crashouts 130.36

The closest game of the week went to Chase’n Skattehoes by 11.24 points. Chase’n climbed back to 3-3 with its best argument yet for relevance, while the Crashouts slipped to 4-2. Nobody actually crashed out here, but 11.24 points were enough to send them home quietly.

Allen town 105.26, Pukakke 91.14

Allen town escaped with a 14.12-point win despite posting the week’s second-lowest score. That is the fantasy equivalent of tripping over the finish line and still getting the medal. Allen town improves to 5-1. Pukakke remains winless at 0-6 after recording the lowest total of the week.

Biggest Win and Closest Game

  • Biggest win: OguguaAnunoby defeated alexvandeusen by 67.68 points, 184.46-116.78.
  • Closest game: Chase’n Skattehoes defeated RoCknCoCk Crashouts by 11.24 points, 141.60-130.36.

Official SBF Network Power Rankings

Rank Team Record Power Score Official Reason
1 OguguaAnunoby 4-2 94 Elite scoring, a 4-2 record and a 184.46-point current week complement Gibbs, London, Walker, Kittle and strong depth.
2 Kirkumcised Penix 5-1 91 The 5-1 record, solid scoring and core of Lamb, Cook, Henry, Flowers and Kelce outweigh Daniels' current absence.
3 Allen town 5-1 88 A 5-1 start and Allen, Bijan, Hampton, Smith and Kincaid provide an excellent foundation, though current-week scoring has dipped.
4 RoCknCoCk Crashouts 4-2 84 A 4-2 record pairs with premium starters Amon-Ra, McBride, Kyren and Irving, but Brown's IR status reduces receiving depth.
5 Secret service chat 3-3 80 League-leading total points and a 152.3-point current week elevate this 3-3 team, despite Etienne being out.
6 arupert12 2-4 76 Strong total points and a deep Mahomes, Taylor, Jefferson, Higgins and Olave core counterbalance the 2-4 record and Jefferson's absence.
7 alexvandeusen 3-3 71 McCaffrey, Burrow and Bowers anchor a talented 3-3 roster, but the latest 116.78 score and absences of Collins and Hall create concern.
8 Chase’n Skattehoes 3-3 66 A 141.6-point current week and Chase-led receiving group offer upside, but mediocre overall scoring, quarterback uncertainty and a 3-3 record limit confidence.
9 Chef Boyardee 1-5 52 Barkley, Nabers, Wilson and Warren provide meaningful talent, but a 1-5 record, low total scoring and multiple unavailable reserves hurt the outlook.
10 Pukakke 0-6 29 Lamar, Rice and LaPorta preserve upside, but an 0-6 record, league-low scoring, a 91.14 current week and Nacua's absence demand last place.

Fraud Watch

  • Allen town: The 5-1 record is elite, but 105.26 points was the lowest winning score of Week 3. The standings say contender; this week’s scoreboard says “please do not investigate further.”
  • RoCknCoCk Crashouts: A 4-2 record remains strong, but the season scoring margin is only 0.24 points: 417.76 scored and 417.52 allowed. That cushion is thinner than a waiver claim with a zero-dollar bid.
  • Chef Boyardee: A respectable 138.88-point week still ended in defeat, and the record is now 1-5. At some point the Chef has to serve wins, not just competitive-looking plates.

Stock Up

  • OguguaAnunoby: A 184.46-point explosion, a 4-2 record and the official No. 1 ranking make this the clearest riser on the board.
  • Secret service chat: The league leader with 441.96 total points added a 152.30-point victory and returned to .500.
  • Chase’n Skattehoes: A 141.60-point win moved the team to 3-3 and provided some needed momentum.
  • Kirkumcised Penix: Another 150.98 points and a 5-1 record keep this team planted firmly among the championship favorites.

Stock Down

  • alexvandeusen: The 116.78-point showing resulted in a 67.68-point loss, and the team has now allowed a league-high 471.34 points.
  • arupert12: The 432.42 season points are strong, but the record is 2-4. That is premium production wearing discount-bin results.
  • Chef Boyardee: The weekly score improved, but the record fell to 1-5.
  • Pukakke: A league-low 91.14 this week, 285.90 total points and an 0-6 record leave nowhere to hide.

Weekly Awards

  • Team of the Week: OguguaAnunoby, for leading the league with 184.46 points.
  • Statement Win: OguguaAnunoby, for the week’s largest margin at 67.68 points.
  • Cardiac Finish Award: Chase’n Skattehoes, winner of the closest matchup by 11.24 points.
  • Escape Artist Award: Allen town, which won with only 105.26 points.
  • Good Score, Bad Timing Award: Chef Boyardee, whose 138.88 points were not enough against Secret service chat.
  • Basement Inspection Award: Pukakke, now 0-6 after scoring a weekly-low 91.14.

Commissioner’s Closing Message

Week 3 is in the books. OguguaAnunoby owns the power-ranking throne, Kirkumcised Penix and Allen town own the best records, and Pukakke currently owns a six-loss punch card nobody asked for. Keep lineups active, monitor unavailable players and remember: the standings forgive ugly wins, but the group chat never does.
